We want to keep the source at 100 for the next round.  
If we take \(X\) units, the rest is \(100-X\).  
After the round the source doubles and gets 5 more units:  
\(2(100-X)+5 = 205-2X\).  
To keep this at 100 we need \(205-2X \ge 100 \Rightarrow X \le 52.5\).  
Since requests must be whole numbers, the largest safe request is 52 units.
